text:
Anika (AE): Procurement at Meridian wants final DPA + order form before issuing PO. They also want AES-HSM language and EU invoicing to their DE subsidiary. tagging @Sam @Olivia :eyes:

Dev (SE): Do they want Hosted or Dedicated? HSM wording differs.

Anika (AE): Dedicated. They require BYOK and HSM attestations.

Sam (Legal): Okay. Send their redlines and sample HSM clause. We'll prepare a DPA with an HSM appendix and a clean order form.

Anika (AE): Dropped redlines: https://files.example/meridian/dpa-redline.pdf

Dev (SE): For BYOK on Dedicated we support customer KMS imports via PKCS#11 gateway. Need to confirm key rotation responsibilities. Recommend text: "Customer retains sole control of key material; Redwood will not access plaintext keys without explicit written authorization."

Sam (Legal): I'll soften "will not access" to reference the KMS appendix and add audit/tracing obligations. Also flag: they requested SLA credit of 10% for downtime >0.1% monthly. That's excessive. Propose capped credits per order form and standard SLA language.

Olivia (Finance): For DE invoicing we need VAT ID and company billing address. Payment terms: they asked net45; our standard is net30. Can we make an exception for Strategic POC?

Anika (AE): They asked net45 specifically. Deal size: $54k annual commit.

Olivia (Finance): Finance can accept net45 on a case-by-case. Need procurement confirmation and escalation to AR. Will accept DocuSign or signed PDF if auditor trail present.

esign-bot: E-sign note: accept external signer if audit log, signer identity and IP recorded. See internal guide: https://internal.redwood/esign-certs

Sam (Legal): Action plan:
- Draft clean DPA + HSM appendix
- Tweak SLA credits to capped schedule in order form
- Produce order form with billing entity selector and net45 option noted
ETA EOD local.

Dev (SE): I'll attach deployment checklist and BYOK integration note for Meridian infra.

Anika (AE): Great. Also they want an "Order of Execution" clause to pin model versions for first 60 days. Sam, can you add brief language?

Sam (Legal): Will add: "Customer may request model pinning for initial 60 days; Redwood will not alter pinned model absent written notice or security/compatibility constraints."

Olivia (Finance): Once Sam posts clean docs, I'll confirm AR acceptance and send billing instructions to Meridian. Please cc billing@redwood on signed order and PO.

Anika (AE): Thanks team. I'll follow up with Meridian procurement for VAT and PO timing. :white_check_mark:
